words.image_desc_cn: 进步和改进的可视化表示。
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 progressed, 过去分词 progressed)
words.collocations: make progress, slow progress, steady progress
words.preposition_combos: progress in, progress on, progress towards

examples.en: We are making good progress in our English studies this term.
examples.cn: 这学期我们在英语学习方面取得了良好的进展。

examples.en: The school has progressed a lot in the past few years.
examples.cn: 这所学校在过去的几年里进步了很多。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的学习成绩比以前提高了，你会用哪个词来描述这种变化？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示朝着目标前进，变得更好。

sentences: The project is showing significant ___ after the new strategies were implemented.

image_prompts: A wooden matchstick with a lit flame, smoke rising upwards
Two soccer teams facing each other on a green field, stadium lights shining
words.image_desc_en: A lit matchstick; a soccer game.
words.image_desc_cn: 一根点燃的火柴；一场足球比赛。
words.meaning_cn: n. 比赛；火柴 v. 相配；比得上
words.usage: n. 比赛；火柴；v. (matched, matched) 相配；比得上
words.collocations: football match, a box of matches, match well, match wits

examples.en: Our school team has an important football match next Saturday.
examples.cn: 我们学校的队伍下周六有一场重要的足球比赛。

examples.en: Her shoes match her bag perfectly, creating a stylish look.
examples.cn: 她的鞋子和包完美搭配，营造出时尚的外观。

socratic_questions.question: 在体育运动中，两队或多队之间进行的竞争活动叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 通常指有规则和计分的对抗。

sentences: The color of her dress doesn't ___ her eyes at all.

image_prompts: A group of colorful puzzle pieces fitting together perfectly, teamwork concept
A flock of geese flying in a V formation across a sunset sky, cooperation
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting cooperation and working together.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘合作和协同工作的图像。
words.usage: n. (复数 teams); v. 组队
words.collocations: sports team, work as a team, join a team

examples.en: Our school basketball team is practicing hard for the game.
examples.cn: 我们学校的篮球队正在为比赛努力训练。

examples.en: The project team needs to work together to meet the deadline.
examples.cn: 项目团队需要一起努力才能按时完成任务。

socratic_questions.question: 如果很多人为了一个共同的目标一起努力，你会怎么称呼他们？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示为了共同目标而合作的一群人。

sentences: The success of the project depends on the entire ___'s effort.

image_prompts: A group of colorful backpacks arranged neatly on a luggage rack, each tagged with a different name, except one which is marked 'Ours'
A family-sized pizza cut into slices, with one slice clearly marked as 'Ours' using a toothpick flag
words.image_desc_en: Belonging to us.
words.image_desc_cn: 属于我们的。
words.collocations: none

examples.en: This beautiful garden is ours to enjoy during the summer.
examples.cn: 这个美丽的花园是我们的，可以在夏天享受。

examples.en: The victory was truly ours after all the hard work.
examples.cn: 经过所有的努力，胜利确实是我们的。

socratic_questions.question: 如果我和我的朋友们共同拥有一辆自行车，我们可以怎么说这辆自行车？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 需要一个表示“属于我们”的词。

sentences: That blue car parked outside is definitely ___ , we bought it last month.

image_prompts: A compass spinning wildly, unable to find north, indicating a loss of direction
A single sock lying on the floor, its pair missing, symbolizing something lost
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting loss of direction and a missing sock.
words.image_desc_cn: 图片描绘了迷失方向和丢失的袜子。
words.collocations: lose weight, lose control, lose hope, lose interest

examples.en: Don't lose your key; you won't be able to enter the house.
examples.cn: 不要丢你的钥匙；你将无法进入房子。

examples.en: Our team didn't want to lose the important basketball game.
examples.cn: 我们的队伍不想输掉这场重要的篮球比赛。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你参加比赛，结果不如人意，没有获得胜利，你会怎么描述这个结果？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示没有赢得比赛，或者遗失了某物。

sentences: If you don't practice, you might ___ the game easily.

image_prompts: A locker decorated with stickers and photos in a school hallway
A group of backpacks piled up near a basketball court
words.image_desc_en: Images representing the environment and belongings of a teenager.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表青少年环境和所属物品的图像。
words.collocations: typical teenager, troubled teenager

examples.en: Every teenager faces challenges as they grow into adulthood.
examples.cn: 每个青少年在成长为成年人的过程中都会面临挑战。

examples.en: She is a teenager who enjoys playing basketball after school.
examples.cn: 她是一个放学后喜欢打篮球的青少年。

socratic_questions.question: 你如何称呼一个年龄在13到19岁之间的人？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词描述的是一个处于青春期的人。

sentences: The school organized a special event for every ___ in the community.

image_prompts: A name tag with the name 'Steve' printed in bold letters, placed on a neatly folded shirt
A digital display showing 'Steve' in a modern font, against a background of abstract geometric shapes
words.image_desc_en: Visual representations of the name 'Steve'.
words.image_desc_cn: 名字 'Steve' 的视觉呈现。
words.collocations: Meet Steve, Steve's friend, Call Steve
words.preposition_combos: with Steve, from Steve, to Steve

examples.en: I met Steve at the school's English club last week.
examples.cn: 我上周在学校的英语俱乐部遇到了史蒂夫。

examples.en: Steve and I are planning a trip to the museum together.
examples.cn: 史蒂夫和我计划一起去博物馆旅行。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你要介绍一个新朋友，他的名字是男性常见的英文名，你会怎么称呼他？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个名字通常用于称呼男性，并且比较常见。

sentences: My classmate, _____, is very good at playing basketball after school.
